text:
Sanjay Kumar: Heads-up: customer ran into an odd accounting delta where confirmed tokens > provisional after a mid-stream shard handoff. Ledger looks like confirmed happened on two shards and summed to more than the provisional reserve. Not a simple retry duplicate. Anyone seen split-confirm aggregation go wrong?

Mei Tanaka: that sounds messy. shard handoff + streaming suffix replay could produce partial confirms on each shard. Do you have the ledger trace?

Sanjay Kumar: heres a simplified excerpt (trace id: shard-2026-07-12-21):

```
2026-07-12T11:22:10Z TRACE trace=shard-2026-07-12-21 sess=0x2a toolcall_id=tc-11 provisional_tokens=90
2026-07-12T11:22:11Z INFO shardA resume replayed=30 sess=0x2a confirm_shard toolcall_id=tc-11 confirmed=60 shard=shardA
2026-07-12T11:22:12Z INFO shardB replay remainder sess=0x2b confirm_shard toolcall_id=tc-11 confirmed=40 shard=shardB
# aggregator later sums confirmed=100 -> confirmed > provisional(90)
```

Oscar Ruiz: if aggregator blindly sums per-shard confirms without deduping overlapping token ranges, you can overshoot. We usually rely on non-overlapping suffix handoffs, but in this case suffix ranges overlapped by 10 tokens due to off-by-one in the replay window calculation.

billing-bot: Detected accounting mismatch for toolcall tc-11: provisional=90, aggregated_confirmed=100. Created alert BILL-10021.

Mei Tanaka: fix options: 1) make confirms include explicit token-range (start_idx, end_idx) and have aggregator compute union of confirmed ranges instead of summing. 2) add a per-toolcall canonicalizer that accepts idempotent confirm events and applies compare-and-swap on aggregated_confirmed to ensure it never exceeds the max provisional if no explicit reserve increase happened. 3) tighten replay windows to ensure no overlap.

Sanjay Kumar: option 1 seems correct long-term (range union) but bigger change: confirm events must be richer and upstream runtime needs to emit ranges. Option 2 is a conservative guard: aggregator enforces aggregated_confirmed = min(aggregated_confirmed, max(provisional, aggregated_confirmed)). But that feels like papering over the real overlap bug.

Oscar Ruiz: also need console visibility. Ops had no easy way to see "confirmed shards" vs "provisional reserve" timeline. We should add timeline spans: confirm.shard={shardA,shardB} with range tags and a per-toolcall unioned_confirmed token-count shown.

Mei Tanaka: telemetry tasks: billing.confirm_ranges counter (labels: shard,toolcall,start,end), billing.aggregator_clamp_events counter (why we had to clamp), and stream.replay_window_overlap gauge. I'll add those metrics and an alert rule: if aggregator_clamp_events > 0 -> paging to eng-platform + billing.

Sanjay Kumar: also consider adding an internal API change: routing.handshake should include a last-acknowledged-token index so new shard knows safe resume point and avoids overlapping replay. That requires small changes in routing protocol but could remove the root cause.

Oscar Ruiz: API debate: tight coupling vs eventual consistency. If we make handshake synchronous (last-ack index), we prevent overlap but increase handshake latency and complexity for cross-shard failovers. Alternatively, keep eventual flow but strengthen idempotent confirm semantics and aggregator union logic.

Mei Tanaka: proposal: short-term do aggregator union+clamp + console visibility + metric alerts. Medium-term change routing.handshake to include last_ack to reduce overlap risk. Long-term restructure confirm to include explicit ranges.

billing-bot: Placing temporary hold on billing for affected invoice window and flagging entries for manual review. Ticket BILL-10021 created.

Sanjay Kumar: I'll open GH issue with repro harness that simulates overlapping replay windows across shards and attach ledger & traces. Will include suggested aggregator patch (range-union fallback).

Oscar Ruiz: rollout plan: deploy aggregator union logic behind feature flag billing.aggregator_range_union=true in canary, monitor billing.aggregator_clamp_events and billing.net_charge_delta. Add console toggle to show per-toolcall confirm ranges when enabled.

Mei Tanaka: I'll add unit tests for range union correctness and an integration test for cross-shard replay overlap. Also update the rollout docs to explain the new console field and how ops should interpret clamped vs unioned confirms.

Sanjay Kumar: great. assigning ENG-7120 P1. Will post PR + canary graphs here. Closing thread for now.
